## ShAnalyzeMaxDepthError class

Command-bearing nesting exceeded this analyzer's fixed structural budget. Linear pipelines and Boolean chains do not consume additional nesting budget. No partial command inventory is returned, so a refusal cannot resemble an empty inventory. Callers decide how this affects their own policy.
